data.name: Dorothea
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Dorothea means 'gift of God' or 'gifted one'. In Christianity, Saint Dorothea is the patron saint of gardeners and martyrs. She is said to have hidden in a garden when persecuted for her faith, and was eventually discovered and beheaded.

in_hebrew.name: דורותיאה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דורותיאה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו במילים היווניות 'דורוס' ו'תיאה', שפירושם מתנה של אלוהים. השם משלב את המילים 'דורוס', שפירושו מתנה, עם הסיומת 'תיאה', שפירושها אלוהים. דורותיאה הוא שם שמשדר כוח רוחני וקשר לאלוהים, ומשמש כזכרון לתקופת השקמה הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Δωροθέα
in_greek.long_meaning: Δωροθέα είναι το θηλυκό ισοδύναμο του αρσενικού ονόματος Δωρόθεος, που σημαίνει «δώρο του Θεού». Το όνομα προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις «δωρον» που σημαίνει δώρο και «θεός» που σημαίνει Θεός. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Δωροθέα δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα, αλλά η έννοια της δωρεάς από τον Θεό είναι κεντρική στο χριστιανικό μήνυμα. Το όνομα Δωροθέα ήταν κοινό στην αρχαία Ελλάδα και διατηρήθηκε στη μεσαιωνική και σύγχρονη εποχή ως σύμβολο πνευματικής γενναιοδοσίας.

in_latin.name: Dorothea
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Dorothea origine Graeco, constat ex vocibus 'doron', quod donum significat, et 'theos', quod Deum significat. Nomen Christianum Dorothea Dei donum interpretatur, habens profundam significationem spiritualem. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Dorothea habebatur in honore virtutis et pietatis. Usus eius per saecula manet, dum significat gratiam et munificentiam divinam.

in_english.name: Dorothea
in_english.long_meaning: The name Dorothea originates from the Greek words 'doron', meaning gift, and 'theos', meaning God. It signifies a gift from God, conveying spiritual significance and divine favor. Historically, Dorothea has been used in Christian tradition to denote a person blessed with spiritual gifts and graces. The name gained popularity in the Middle Ages due to its association with several Christian saints, notably Saint Dorothea of Cappadocia. Today, Dorothea remains a revered name across Christian cultures, symbolizing faith, piety, and the grace of God.

saint_reference.note: A 4th-century martyr and saint in the Christian tradition.

seo.meta_description: Explore the Greek name Dorothea, which means 'gift of God' and holds significance in both Greek mythology and Christianity. Discover its origins and cultural/religious usage.
seo.description_paragraph: Dorothea is a beautiful Greek name with deep meaning and cultural significance. Originating from the Greek words 'doron' (gift) and 'theos' (God), Dorothea translates to 'gift of God' or 'gifted one'. In Greek mythology, Dorothea is revered as a symbol of divine favor and blessings. In Christianity, Saint Dorothea is a revered martyr who hid in a garden when persecuted for her faith, eventually discovering the power of inner strength and devotion. This name continues to resonate with people today, offering a meaningful connection to both ancient Greek and Christian traditions.
